item.title: Epstein-Barr virus activity may signal multiple sclerosis attacks
item.description: A new study sheds light on the link between the Epstein-Barr virus and multiple sclerosis, suggesting a causal role for reactivation.

item.title: AACR annual report highlights promising advances for cancer patients
item.description: The American Association for Cancer Research has released the 16th edition of its annual Cancer Progress Report, a comprehensive overview.

item.title: AI screens 7,000 drugs to find one active against resistant pneumonia strains
item.description: Streptococcus pneumoniae causes life-threatening infections such as pneumonia and meningitis, and these infections are becoming harder to treat.

item.title: Fourth measles death reported in Pennsylvania
item.description: Pennsylvania officials have reported a fourth measles-associated death, involving an 18-year-old resident of Mifflin County.
